name: Wearable Sensors HAR Benchmark
description: Benchmarks human activity recognition algorithms using wearable sensor data (e.g., accelerometer, gyroscope) across standard tasks and splits.
reputation: Widely used within the HCI/ubiquitous-computing and activity-recognition communities as a standard sensor-based HAR evaluation setup, though adoption varies by dataset variant.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on wearable time-series data; many datasets are small or have few subjects, subject-dependent variability and class imbalance; some tasks are saturated by specialized models and there is risk of overfitting to dataset-specific sensor placements.
